description: An exe.dev favicon emoji links to where to change it. The page runs on host myvm.exe.xyz, and the server's favicon emoji 🧪 comes from exe.dev. "The picker" is the dialog whose accessible name is "Favicon emoji"; "the favicon" is the element link[rel="icon"]. Call "puts" lists, as a JSON array, the emojis the page has asked the server to save. To "open the picker": press_key "k" with modifiers "Control" (on whatever has focus); fill ".command-palette-input" with "favicon emoji"; click the first ".command-palette-item"; then the picker should be visible. "The search box" is the picker's input[type=search]; it sits inside the emoji-picker element's shadow root, which CSS selectors cannot reach, so pick it as the element with role "combobox" and accessible name exactly "Search" (exact), with "within" the picker. An "option" is an element with role "option" inside the picker. To "type" text means a type step, with no click first: the keys go to whatever has focus. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. [data-testid="message-input"] should be visible. 3. Navigate to /new again. 4. Open the picker (no focus check). 5. The favicon's href attribute must be exactly {{TEST_TUBE}}. 6. The link inside the picker whose accessible name is "Change it on exe.dev" must have the href attribute exactly "https://exe.dev/vm/myvm". 7. There must be exactly 0 "emoji-picker" elements inside the picker. 8. Press Escape. 9. The picker should become hidden. 10. Call "puts": it must return exactly [].
